missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Американец' is the nominative predicate noun identifying the neighbour. The fleeting vowel -е- appears in this base nominative form before the soft sign drops in other cases.

Strategic focus: Animate accusative equals genitive. 'Американца' is accusative, and because the noun is animate masculine it copies the genitive form. The fleeting -е- drops, giving the stem 'американц-'.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Американца' is genitive after 'у', expressing possession. The fleeting vowel disappears, and 'этого' agrees in the masculine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Американцу' is dative after 'помочь', which governs the dative. The fleeting -е- drops and the masculine dative ending -у is added.

missions.phrase: Она познакомилась с американцем в кафе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Американцем' is instrumental governed by 'с'. The fleeting vowel drops, and the soft-stem masculine instrumental ending is -ем.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Американце' is prepositional after 'об', describing the topic of conversation. The fleeting -е- drops before the prepositional ending -е.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Американец' is the nominative subject of 'работает'. 'Этот' agrees in the masculine nominative, and the full fleeting-vowel form is preserved here.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Американцев' is genitive plural after 'много'. The fleeting vowel drops, and the soft-stem masculine genitive plural ending is -ев.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Американцы' is the nominative plural subject of 'изучают'. The fleeting vowel drops in the plural stem, and 'эти' agrees in the plural.

missions.phrase: Я пригласил двух американцев на ужин.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Animate accusative plural equals genitive. 'Американцев' is accusative plural and copies the genitive plural because the noun is animate. The numeral 'двух' also stands in the genitive.
